subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A science fair displayed a 3D-printed hand made for a child who had lost fingers.”?
options: Students debated whether such farms could replace traditional farms.
Many said it helped them feel less nervous.
It was small and uneven, but she took many pictures.
It was lighter and cheaper than many traditional devices.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Students debated whether such farms could replace traditional farms.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Many said it helped them feel less nervous.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It was small and uneven, but she took many pictures.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「It was lighter and cheaper than many traditional devices.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「It was lighter and cheaper than many traditional devices.」，答案為「It was lighter and cheaper than many traditional devices.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It was lighter and cheaper than many traditional devices.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
